Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Identified standing lines using stumps and a flagpole.

Described that line direction can differ while both lines remain straight.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Om practised naming line directions through examples such as stumps, a crossbar, a flagpole and a slide. They explained that a line can lean to the side and still be straight; the slide was first described as partly curved, then later identified as a slanting straight line (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask Om to find and name one standing, one sleeping and one slanting straight line around the house.
